lines.text: Give someone a way to find the right people, papers and household details without putting every secret in one folder.

eyebrow.text: Check the file after a meaningful change

items.text: Replace superseded directions clearly rather than leaving conflicting versions in several folders.
Review access after changing a lock, device, provider or security arrangement.
Ask the appropriate person whether the directions are understandable.

line.text: This is that file, kept current rather than written once, and printable as a book somebody could pick up and use.
